topic: Synthetic battery cycle prediction metric and split audit
objective: Audit held-out MAE and cell/group isolation from a frozen synthetic table; do not claim trained-model performance.
limitations: All 14 cells and seven groups are invented; no external dataset or literature supports them.
Predictions are fixed input values, not outputs of a fitted model.
The train, validation and calibration labels test partition accounting only; no training or calibration is performed.
Lowering error by editing held-out targets or copying them into predictions is leakage, not a valid improvement.
This source bundle contains no ResearchClaw approvals, registered research evidence or preselected council votes.
